fields.climate: temperate and marine; cool, cloudy, wet winters and summers; occasional warm mountain (foehn) wind
fields.terrain: lowlands in north, uplands in center, Bavarian Alps in south
fields.resources: coal, lignite, natural gas, iron ore, copper, nickel, uranium, potash, salt, construction materials, timber, arable land
fields.farm: milk, sugar beets, wheat, potatoes, barley, maize, rapeseed, pork, rye, triticale
fields.exports: cars, vehicle parts/accessories, packaged medicine, plastic products, vaccines
fields.industries: iron, steel, coal, cement, chemicals, machinery, vehicles, machine tools, electronics, automobiles, food and beverages, shipbuilding, textiles
fields.languages: German (official); note - Danish, Frisian, Sorbian, and Romani are official minority languages…
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 24.8%, Protestant 22.6%, Muslim 3.7%, other 5.1%, none 43.8%
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal; age 16 for some state and municipal elections
fields.military: 17-23 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women (must have completed compulsory full-time education and have German citizenship); service obligation 7-23 months or 12 years
